entities.name: Nguyễn Hoàng Ngân
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nguyễn Hoàng Ngân is a Vietnamese karateka competing in the women's kata event. She won the gold medal in the women's kata event at the 2008 World Karate Championships in Tokyo, Japan. She is also a two-time silver medalist at the Asian Games.
